findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Mandatory Shopify compliance requests and app uninstall cannot enter a verified durable lifecycle path.
findings.plan_claim: Uninstall and privacy lifecycle must stop access and execute documented retention/deletion policy.
findings.contract_claim: customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact plus app/uninstalled require valid HMAC, durable idempotent claim and retry-safe handling.
findings.runtime_fact: Only an uncomposed planner/executor exists; no production webhook route or HMAC handler was found.
findings.schema_fact: No webhook claim/event table or deletion run/evidence table was found.
findings.live_evidence: Canonical shopify.app.toml has no webhooks or compliance_topics section.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Foundation Done does not provide operational compliance handling.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not deploy app config or simulate destructive events during audit.
findings.remediation_dependency: Exact manifest and durable lifecycle persistence design.
findings.acceptance_needed: Configured subscriptions, invalid-HMAC 401, durable 2xx claim, retry/replay tests and development-store evidence.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: A user can be told that Delete My Data/hard deletion is scheduled while product data and credentials are not deleted.
findings.plan_claim: Delete My Data executes a versioned workspace deletion manifest and exposes completion.
findings.contract_claim: Workspace access/jobs/provider operations stop, credentials and data are deleted or anonymized, and minimum redacted evidence survives.
findings.runtime_fact: Legacy route updates only subscriptions.status, deleted_at and hard_delete_at; no 90-day executor was found.
findings.schema_fact: No durable workspace deletion request/run/step/completion authority exists.
findings.live_evidence: Repository UI displays Delete My Data and a 90-day hard-delete statement. Production reachability of the legacy surface remains independently unverified.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Visible product promise materially exceeds runtime behavior.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not trigger the current delete endpoint as a test.
findings.remediation_dependency: Canonical manifest executor and product-surface consolidation.
findings.acceptance_needed: End-to-end deletion evidence across every manifest category, access/session shutdown and completion UI.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: After merchant uninstall, provider credentials and operations may remain usable because no verified event is composed to shutdown operations.
findings.plan_claim: Uninstall immediately stops new provider operations and SnapshotJobs without pretending all data is deleted.
findings.contract_claim: Verified app/uninstalled authority performs fail-closed access/job/token shutdown.
findings.runtime_fact: disable_access and remove_shop_tokens are abstract ports used only by tests; no webhook route/event store/operations composition was found.
findings.schema_fact: Installation supports uninstalled status but no durable transition/claim authority was found.
findings.live_evidence: One active installation and one active workspace exist; no uninstall acceptance evidence exists.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: A status enum and planner do not create an operational uninstall boundary.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not uninstall the development app during audit.
findings.remediation_dependency: AF-A3-001 lifecycle ingress plus immediate-stop implementation.
findings.acceptance_needed: Verified uninstall causes no subsequent provider/job calls, removes local Shopify token material and records redacted evidence.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: A terminally deleted shop could revive old workspace authority or overlap old/new generations on reinstall.
findings.plan_claim: Terminal deletion followed by clean reinstall creates a new workspace generation and never restores old Dataset, token or binding.
findings.contract_claim: Old workspace reaches terminal deletion before new authority; no automatic copy or authority overlap.
findings.runtime_fact: complete_shopify_managed_install upserts same shop_id to active with the same workspace_id and does not increment install_generation.
findings.schema_fact: shopify_installations is unique by shop_id, shop_domain and workspace_id; no terminal deletion generation ledger exists.
findings.live_evidence: Current installation is active generation 1; no clean-reinstall acceptance evidence exists.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: The current upsert can model ordinary reinstall but cannot prove terminal clean reinstall semantics.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not test by deleting the live development workspace.
findings.remediation_dependency: Terminal deletion state/evidence and generation authority.
findings.acceptance_needed: Two tested paths: pre-redact reinstall reuses authority only before deletion; post-deletion reinstall creates a new isolated workspace generation.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Workspace deletion can partially fail or leave unknown data because exact table/object order is not contracted.
findings.plan_claim: Deletion follows an approved manifest and dependency order.
findings.contract_claim: Every category is classified delete, anonymize or legally retain.
findings.schema_fact: Authority inventory spans canonical and legacy tables; workspace dependencies include both CASCADE and RESTRICT rules.
findings.live_evidence: No deletion run/step or legal-retention record exists.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Category list is not an executable dependency-safe manifest.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not infer ON DELETE CASCADE as complete privacy deletion.
findings.remediation_dependency: Full authority/data inventory including storage and external systems.
findings.acceptance_needed: Versioned exact manifest, dry-run inventory, partial-failure resume and zero-residue checks.

findings.customer_or_platform_failure: Webhook replay isolation and workspace-wide deletion behavior can diverge from the frozen contract.
findings.plan_claim: Executable lifecycle contract is the authority.
findings.contract_claim: Replay key is shop_id + topic + webhook_event_id and shop_redact executes the approved workspace manifest.
findings.runtime_fact: event_store.claim receives only shop_id and event_id; shop_redact action list names only shop personal data deletion.
findings.schema_fact: No durable schema exists to enforce the contract key or manifest steps.
findings.live_evidence: Only unit tests with in-memory mock ports pass.
findings.contradiction_or_gap: Planner/executor foundation predates and does not fully implement E10-T4-B.
findings.safe_boundary: Do not mark foundation tests as operational PASS.
findings.remediation_dependency: Versioned contract-to-runtime alignment after manifest approval.
findings.acceptance_needed: Cross-topic same-ID negative test, replay test and full manifest action evidence.
